capture: Playwright Chromium against the local dev app; viewport screenshots encoded directly as WebP. No DOM content replacement, mockup, invented market data or image overlays.
identity: The e2e suite’s automatically generated froggy.local-identity. Identity, wallet, payments and credit funding remain stubbed. Browser and chart evidence were acquired separately under the owner’s $1 provider-spend authorization.
credentials: The pictured MCP token was created only on the disposable local stub server, exercised against /mcp, then revoked.

prices.notes: Shipped liveBirdeye adapter after correcting the documented unix_time timestamp. Real unpadded USD closes; the spot-price request returned 429, so token remains null.

browser.capture: Playwright local /browser, with browser WebSocket state and viewer URL forwarded from the live adapter. Provider viewer rendered directly; no replacement HTML or pixels. agentNavigate opened the public IANA Example Domains page. Take the page changed actual control to human; Resume appeared.
browser.cleanup: Provider status stopped confirmed; temporary profile deleted.
browser.limitation: Provider iframe raised a sandboxed document.cookie access error after rendering. Capture, takeover and shutdown assertions passed; the temporary live script’s final zero-page-errors assertion did not. The iframe sandbox was not weakened.

captureNotes: Capture used the normal e2e server settings on 3540/3541 with a temporary isolated Vite cache and HMR disabled to avoid concurrent development reloads. Playwright waits for a PNG paint before Chromium encodes the same viewport as WebP.
